limitations: This is a structural floorplan precursor, not the full HBM die.
PV affinity screen uses real source oy pins and memory wd_in pins; selection mux/capture/registered pipeline are absent. It is an optimistic adjacency metric, not actual routed/netlist wirelength.
One fullH16 engine:32logicaltiles, proposed logicaltile=physicalpair; exact assignment still needs source binding.
Canonical NE VM WG1 output and RG3 query, KV multi-stack source/PHY, all SM/SU/IDX/COLL/clock children must enter the common graph before adoption.
tile_local_rebank is an explicit larger-memory successor, not canonical source; 2048 banks, epoch-only address, requires new RTL, clocks and compiler/consumer proof.
Query64/staging34/programme1 shelves retain all hardware counts but their connectivity is not optimized here.
No native/timing/cut/clock/PG/pin-access qualification; no performance estimate.
